resources.string: Fallout 2 CE needs the files of your own copy of Fallout 2 (GOG, Steam or the disc).\n\nCopy the game\'s folder from your computer to the phone — by cable, through a cloud drive or a messenger (as one archive: .zip, .7z or .rar) — and choose it here. Installed mods (RPU and others) and saves come along.
No Fallout 2 here: master.dat and critter.dat weren\'t found. Choose the folder or the archive Fallout 2 is installed in.
There are several copies of the game here: %s. Choose a folder or an archive with one of them.
To copy: %1$s, free on the phone: %2$s
Not enough free space on the phone: %1$s more is needed.
The file can\'t be read as an archive. .zip, .7z, .rar and .tar work — or choose the game\'s folder.
The archive is protected with a password. Unpack it (on the phone or a computer) and choose the game\'s folder.
This is a part of a split archive, or the archive wasn\'t downloaded completely. Choose the whole archive as one file, or unpack it and choose the game\'s folder.
The archive is compressed in a way that can\'t be read here (%s). Unpack it and choose the game\'s folder, or pack it again as .zip or .7z.
The archive is damaged (%s). Copy or download it again.
This file can\'t be read in place. Copy the archive to the phone\'s storage (Downloads, for example) and choose it there.

Choose a folder or an archive with the game. The game and its mods become as there — for a whole new build, or to update the mods (then master.dat and critter.dat can be left out: the current ones stay). Saves and your settings stay as they are.
Files to add: %1$d, to replace: %2$d, to remove: %3$d
No master.dat and critter.dat: the game\'s original files stay, the mods are replaced.
The chosen one\'s saves (%d) don\'t come along — "Import saves" is for them.
Replacing cancelled. The game is as it was.
The game hasn\'t closed yet. Close it and try again.
Choose a folder or an archive with saves: the SAVEGAME folder, SLOT folders or the whole game. An export of this game brings their dates and compatibility along.
No Fallout 2 saves here: no SLOT folders with SAVE.DAT were found.
The current saves (%d) will be deleted and replaced with the chosen ones. This can\'t be undone.
Not enough free slots: %1$d needed, %2$d free. Delete saves you don\'t need or choose "Replace all".
Your copy of Fallout 2 is installed. Nothing more is needed here. You can replace it later in Settings, Game files.
The game\'s files aren\'t here yet. Fallout 2 CE needs your own copy of Fallout 2 (GOG, Steam or the disc): a folder, or one archive of it, on this device.
What the bottom screen shows while you explore. Tap one; it can be changed later in Settings.
The Fallout theme draws the bottom screen with the game\'s own interface art and fonts, read from your copy. Classic is plain green. Pip-Boy 2000 is a green CRT console (the default).

The top screen is the world: tap to walk, tap a person or a thing to act on it, touch and hold for the action menu, two fingers to move and zoom the view. The bottom screen holds the buttons: screens (inventory, character, Pip-Boy, map), tools, weapon and the game menu.
B back. Start menu. Y inventory, X skills, L1 character, R1 Pip-Boy, L3 sneak. L2 swaps hands, R2 uses the active item. Hold Select to end the turn. Left stick moves the view, D-pad up and down zoom.

The cursor follows your finger on the top screen. Two fingers tapped together, or touch and hold, right click (the action menu). The TOUCHPAD button on the bottom screen opens a trackpad: drag moves the cursor, tap clicks, hold then drag carries. With a gamepad the right stick moves the cursor; R3 or A click, B or holding R3 right click.
This guide is shown once. Open it again in the game\'s Settings, Setup guide.
